description: This file contains extension methods for configuring dependency injection in an Orleans project. It provides utilities to register existing service implementations within the IServiceCollection, facilitating flexible dependency configuration.

classes.name: ServiceCollectionExtensions
classes.description: A static class containing extension methods for IServiceCollection to facilitate dependency registration.

methods.name: AddFromExisting
methods.description: Registers an existing registration of a specified implementation type as a provider of a service type.

methods.name: AddFromExisting<TService, TImplementation>
methods.description: Generic method to register an existing implementation type as a service, assuming it is already registered.

methods.name: TryAddFromExisting<TService, TImplementation>
methods.description: Registers an existing implementation only if no other implementation of the service type is registered.
